slug: 2024-02-26 Somalia inaugurates its Data Protection Authority

facts.fact: Somalia inaugurated its Data Protection Authority on 24 February 2024, following the Data Protection Law No. 005 of 2023.
The law was ratified by both parliamentary chambers and signed by the President in March 2023; the article gives no commencement date and does not say it is in force.
At the beginning of February 2024 the Authority published guidelines for implementing the law, setting compliance steps; no decision or sanction is reported.
